question: Which stock indexes should investors invest in? Analyze NASDAQ, S&P 500, Dow Jones performances
query: SELECT      date,     stock_index,     open_price AS "S&P 500 OPEN",     close_price AS "S&P 500 CLOSE",     daily_high AS "S&P 500 HIGH",     daily_low AS "S&P 500 LOW",     trading_volume AS "S&P 500 VOLUME" FROM finance_economics_dataset WHERE stock_index IN ('^GSPC', '^DJI') LIMIT 50;
